fact: Action Plan projects more than £50bn of private investment across Industrial Strategy Zones.
gate: Projection is programme-level; exact investment, site and delivery status required.

fact: Action Plan reports more than £6.4bn in private investment already attracted.
gate: Announced/attracted investment must be mapped to an exact site and current project status.

fact: Current Industrial Strategy defines eight growth-driving sectors.
gate: Sector classification alone is not local land-demand evidence.

fact: Homes England estimates support for approximately 280,000 new homes over its 2025-30 plan.
gate: National agency target is not a parcel delivery commitment.

fact: Plan estimates land unlocked with capacity for almost 400,000 homes.
gate: Capacity is portfolio-wide and requires exact site identification.

fact: Agency-supported gross completions are estimated to rise from around 40,000 per year in 2025-26 to more than 80,000 by 2029-30.
gate: Agency trajectory cannot be used as a parcel completion probability.

fact: Government states East West Rail can support up to 100,000 new homes.
gate: Route-wide potential requires exact station, planning and site relation.

fact: Government expects East West Rail to add £6.7bn per year to the regional economy by 2050.
gate: Forecast regional benefit is not parcel uplift evidence.

fact: Government states up to £800m has already been committed to accelerate homes, jobs and infrastructure.
gate: Funding must be traced to exact projects and parcels.

fact: Strategic acquisition is intended to support more than 10,000 homes.
gate: Exact canonical geometry and planning/phasing evidence remain required.

fact: Project announcement identifies around 9,000 jobs.
gate: Jobs estimate requires verified project phasing and parcel relation.

fact: Completed acquisition covers approximately 700 acres including Cambridge City Airport and surrounding land.
gate: Large-site acquisition still needs exact canonical parcel intersection.

fact: Investment prospectus says East West Rail will ultimately connect a region of about 3.5 million people.
gate: Corridor population is not a site-specific demand or value uplift measure.

fact: July 2026 reforms are expected to cut pre-application time by up to 12 months.
gate: Process saving does not establish project approval or construction.

fact: Government estimates reforms could save industry £1bn this Parliament.
gate: System-wide estimate is not site viability evidence.

fact: Government says already green-lit projects are set to create 82,000 jobs.
gate: Aggregate jobs require project-by-project location verification.

fact: 41 major infrastructure projects had been determined by 3 July 2026.
gate: National decision count is not local scheme status.

fact: Government reported 42 major infrastructure decisions by 16 July 2026.
gate: Aggregate decision count cannot be mapped to a parcel without project evidence.

ref: Homes delivered since start of Parliament
fact: Government estimated 392,400 homes delivered from the start of Parliament to 14 June 2026.
gate: National delivery count is not local future supply or parcel evidence.

fact: Multi-year allocations provide £1.3bn capital across England plus an extra £900m for the North and Midlands.
gate: Authority funding must be joined to an exact funded transport scheme and parcel relation.
